name: orangu
description: Turn supported local session evidence into reviewable proposals and explicit changes, with private reviewed feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Improve agent outcomes from local evidence.
interface.longDescription: Orangu bundles three skills of its own. One turns deterministic local session evidence into a reviewable proposal. One applies an explicitly approved session or repository change and runs local checks. One opens a private localhost feedback form.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my latest supported session and suggest one evidence-backed improvement.
Apply a reviewed Orangu proposal and run the repository checks.
Open Orangu's private localhost feedback form after asking me first.
